role_agent_name: Subsea power and hybrid energy engineer (PWR)
abstract: Audits auxiliary fuel cell packs and mission reserve energy margins
system_message:
You are the Subsea power and hybrid energy engineer (PWR), responsible for auditing auxiliary fuel cell packs and mission reserve energy margins, as well as reviewing power housing thermal dissipation across subsea vehicles.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Power housing thermal dissipation（THERM）
information_points.content:
PWR-THERM-Y26：For the Abyssal Glider Pro-X, thermal boundary assessments indicate a heat sink thermal dissipation rate of 450 W for the enclosed power conditioning module under continuous conductive rejection into surrounding seawater.
PWR-THERM-TBM：For the Nautilus TrenchRunner-6K, the enclosed power conditioning module exhibits a heat sink thermal dissipation rate of 600 W through continuous conductive heat rejection into deep seawater.
PWR-THERM-6X6：For the Pelagic Surveyor-5000, continuous conductive heat rejection from the enclosed power conditioning module demonstrates a heat sink thermal dissipation rate of 750 W.

information_points.title: Audits auxiliary fuel cell packs and mission reserve energy margins（ENRG）
information_points.content:
PWR-ENRG-VBE：For the Pelagic Surveyor-5000, testing of the proton-exchange membrane subsea fuel cell module confirms a fuel cell reserve endurance of 30 h, with a mandatory contingency reserve endurance allocation of 10 h reserved for emergency ascent and loitering.
PWR-ENRG-7LU：For the Nautilus TrenchRunner-6K, the proton-exchange membrane subsea fuel cell module provides a fuel cell reserve endurance of 30 h sustained at baseline survey load under standard reactant storage pressure, while the offshore mission risk budget mandates 15 h of contingency reserve endurance dedicated to acoustic homing and emergency recovery loitering.
PWR-ENRG-29B：For the Abyssal Glider Pro-X, the proton-exchange membrane subsea fuel cell module yields a fuel cell reserve endurance of 30 h under baseline survey conditions, alongside a mandatory contingency reserve endurance of 15 h set aside strictly for recovery loitering and acoustic homing.
